name: CSF fish shares
notes: Seed name is generic. I matched it to Local I'a, which FarmLink calls Oʻahu's only CSF. Its Instagram bio lists the Kaimukī storefront (3458 Waiʻalae Ave) hours (Fri 10-6, Sat/Sun 10-2) and the Sunday Mililani farmers market (8-11). Slow Food Oahu confirms the same stops. The Facebook page showed 'Closing soon' in its listing, so hours may have changed. An older third-party profile gives the Facebook name as 'localiacsf', which differs from the URL found here. Storefront is in Kaimukī (town side) and the market is in Mililani (central); phone (808) 492-8331.

name: Sashimi-grade local fish
notes: Generic product description, not a business name. The phrase appears on Local I'a's CSF page, but I could not tie it to one vendor, so I left it null rather than duplicate the Local I'a entry.

name: Dorothy's Lei Stand
notes: Airport lei stand, phone (808) 836-1322. Only third-party mentions found; a 2025 travel guide lists it among the family-owned stands outside HNL baggage claim. Directories give two addresses (300 Rodgers Blvd and 3375 Koapaka St #C300). No official site or social accounts found. Side: town (airport/Honolulu).

name: Cindy's Lei Shoppe
notes: Own site is current (it says 'Voted Hawaii's Best Lei Stand 12 years in a row'). Fixed storefront at 1034 Maunakea St, phone 808-536-6538, so there are no market stops. Its About page gives Mon-Sat 7-5 and Sun 7-4, while hiChinatown shows slightly different hours, so confirm before relying on them. hiChinatown says the shop has Facebook and Instagram pages but the URLs were not visible, so I left them null. Also trades as Cindy's Lei & Flower Shoppe. Side: town.

name: Shirley's Flowers
notes: Chinatown lei shop, 1176/1178 Maunakea St, phone 808-536-2218. Two possible domains appeared only in directory listings (shirleysflowershi.com and shirleysflowers.net). I could not verify either as the business's own site, so website is null. The hiChinatown organizer listing is the only recent-ish source and is undated, so I can't confirm current status. Side: town.

name: Nita's Leis & Flower Shoppe
notes: 59 N Beretania St, phone (808) 521-9065. The Hawaii LLC registry shows Nita's Leis & Flower Shoppe LLC as Active. hiChinatown lists the same address and phone as 'Lita's Leis & Flower Shoppe' and says it has an Instagram, but no URL was visible, so the handle is null. A business directory attached cindysleishoppe.com to this entity; that looks like a data error, so I ignored it. No official site found. Side: town.

name: Island Gifts & Flowers
notes: 69 N Beretania St, phone 808-537-5347, listed in a Hawaii Aloha Travel Chinatown article. One listing site flagged the business as possibly closed in late 2025, and a business directory shows an 'Ohana Leis & Flowers' at the same address. I could not verify either point, so still_active is null. A website domain appeared only on a review site, which I did not use. No official socials found. Side: town.

name: M P Lei Shop
notes: 1145 Maunakea St #2, phone 808-531-3206, listed on the hiChinatown organizer directory. No official site or socials found. Hours vary across directories. Current status is not confirmed by any dated source. Side: town.

name: Pauahi Leis
notes: Listed as Pauahi Leis & Flowers, 1145 Maunakea St #1, phone 808-521-6156. A gift-card site describes it as operating (about 3 months old); the hiChinatown listing is undated and its hours differ between its own pages. No official site or socials found. Side: town.

name: Maunakea Florist
notes: The only match is 'Maunakea Street Florist' at 1189 Maunakea St, phone 808-537-2373, on the hiChinatown directory. I assume it is the same business, but the name is not an exact match. No official presence found and no recent status information. Side: town.

name: Harriet's Lei Stand
notes: Airport stand at 300 Rodgers Blvd Stall #1, phone 808-836-3446 (another directory lists 836-3215). A directory points to an airport-authority vendor page (honolulu-airport.com/shops-and-stores/terminal-2/harriets-lei-stand), but I did not open it, so I did not list it as the website. A 2025 travel guide names it as an operating stand. No own site or socials found. Side: town.

name: Gladys' Lei Stand
notes: Airport stand at 300 Rodgers Blvd #10, phone (808) 836-1059, owner Bonnie Groendyke. KITV (about 14 months old) reported rent and fee increases that put the stand at risk of closing; I found no follow-up, so status is unknown. A business directory says it has a Facebook page but gave no URL. No website found. Side: town.

name: Maile's Lei Stand
notes: Public radio said in April 2023 that it was still at the Honolulu airport. Two map-site listings (phone 808-836-1522) mark it permanently closed, one at 300 Rodgers Blvd and one at 98 Kapalulu Pl. Those are unverified, so status is null. A hulas.com link on one listing is unrelated. No official presence found. Side: town.

name: Watanabe Floral
notes: Handles come from the business's own site markup (Instagram, Facebook, X, Pinterest). Main store at 1618 N. Nimitz Hwy, Honolulu, plus a Waipahu store; phone 808-832-9360, closed Sundays per the hours page. A separate weddings account exists at instagram.com/weddingsbywfi. Fixed storefront and delivery, so no market schedule. Side: town for the Nimitz store, leeward_ewa for Waipahu.

name: Lin's Lei Shop
notes: 1017 Maunakea St Ste A, phone 808-537-4112. The hiChinatown organizer listing links an Instagram, and the handle matches the Apple Maps and directory entries. The website domain linsleishop.com comes from several directory pages (the site's own welcome text appears in one), and I did not open it directly. A 2026 visitor guide lists it as operating. Not the same as Lin's Lei Stand in Hilo on the Big Island, which I excluded. No Facebook page found; order URL not confirmed. Side: town.
